description: Validation dans les transports en commun is a dataset listed in Data Toulouse Metropole open data portal, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by Tisséo. Le nombre de validation en transports en commun s'étend sur un périmètre plus large que Toulouse Métropole. Coverage: Toulouse Métropole. The portal files it under Environnement. Its keywords are mobilité, tisseo, transport, commun, transport en commun, bus. The portal shows 20 records. The portal flags it as a time series. The portal shows 2025-02-18 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Licence Ouverte v2.0 (Etalab). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support public transport network, service and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-data-toulouse-metropole-fr-portal.
